crosscheck.purpose: External-only formula cross-check; report path uses no numpy, scipy or pinned source imports

limitations: All speech and feedback paths are analytic synthetic fixtures; no real recordings, loudspeakers or measured IRs.
The pinned source trains on AMI/SMARD data; this evidence substitutes deterministic synthetic paths and does not reproduce its reported numbers.
The logistic coefficients are trained on this fixture only; they are not real ML model weights and are not a production asset.
No real-model inference, licensed runtime, listening test, device timing, CPU/deadline measurement or release qualification is claimed.
The source screen uses 256-sample frames; this v0-boundary reference uses 160-sample frames with the same formulas.
protocol: Synthetic, dependency-free port of the pinned logistic howl-risk screen: train on two generated resonant paths, evaluate exact features/thresholds on three disjoint generated held-out paths, compare identity, static fallback and logistic gain control.

scope.frame_size_deviation_reason: public v0 is fixed at 160 samples

training.model: class-balanced logistic regression with L2 penalty, 600 gradient steps, 97-point threshold grid; 2-frame persistence, -3 dB per event, -12 dB floor, slow +0.25 dB recovery
training.positive_label: feedback RMS >= 0.65 x target-frame RMS (floored at 3% utterance RMS) and local peak prominence >= 4 dB
